title: THE OATH: Emotional Sacrifice BGM (original score)
description:
A warrior swears an oath he knows will cost him everything, and keeps it. A lone bamboo flute rises into a full choir, the heartbeat stops for the sacrifice, then a hundred voices carry his name.

For fans of emotional BGM, sacrifice scenes, flute themes and goosebump choir music. Headphones on.

Music: The Oath, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
